sents.t: Mr. Lee says, “Sam, you need a bank account for your paycheck.”
On Tuesday, I go to Oakville Bank on Main Street.
There is an ATM outside, and inside there are three tellers.
“Hi. I want to open a bank account.”
“Sure. I need your passport and your address, please.” I give them to Tom.
“Thank you. Do you want a checking account or a savings account?”
“A checking account is for every day. You get a debit card for shopping. A savings account is for saving money for the future.”
After twenty minutes, everything is ready.
“Your debit card comes in the mail in seven to ten days,” Tom says.
Now I have an American bank account!
Maybe one day, I can save money for a car.
